reserves.name: USDm (Mento Dollar) CDP collateral
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Mento Protocol and the shared Mento Reserve

reserveReview.rationale: Mento documents GBPm as debt borrowed against USDm collateral in its FX CDP system, matching the current live Mento row. The reserve is one tracked stablecoin exposure with Mento Reserve, custody, liquidity, and smart-contract failure domains retained.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current live Mento CDP row and Mento CDP documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No additional direct GBPm reserve slice is identified; the upstream Mento Reserve basket is tracked through the linked USDm asset.
